notes.title: New game name! Kingdoms: The Crown!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have changed the name of the game from "KINGS" to "Kingdoms: The Crown". This was primarily so our store page could become more visible. In addition, a new trailer and images were added to show the change from Unity to the Unreal engine.

Please add the game to your wishlist if you haven't already if you are interested in it!

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]

notes.title: Unreal Engine Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

We are just informing you that KINGS will be moved over to the Unreal engine before Early Access release. This was for a number of reasons, such as better networking (which will reduce lag), and graphical capacity. We will have some screenshots to showcase of the Unreal engine soon!

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios    [/h1]
